details: Invalid as stated.  The family $\mathcal H=\{\{1\},\{2\}\}$ has oriented diameter $0$ and diameter $2$.
proof: On its two-coordinate domain, this family has no projection containing both $\varnothing$ and its full coordinate set, so $\mathrm D^+(\mathcal H)=0$.  Its two concepts differ on both coordinates, hence $\mathrm D(\mathcal H)=2$.  No positive universal constant can make the displayed inequality hold.
name: Oriented Diameter / Diameter
